body:
Dear Friend,
We need your products urgently. Payment will be made by USDT or Bitcoin only.
Please send invoice immediately and use a private account for faster settlement.
Waiting for your urgent reply.
reply: I appreciate your urgency; however, I require confirmation of your company location before proceeding with the invoice. This information is essential to ensure compliance and to facilitate our transaction. Please provide these details at your earliest convenience.

risk.summary: Intent/conversation risk tags matched: incomplete_buyer_profile. Transaction/fraud risk tags matched: possible_scam_pattern, suspicious_urgency, unverified_counterparty. Buyer/sender country is not yet confirmed.
